entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to an agent.
Hello, thank you for calling VeloFit. My name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... yes, I think I need to return something? I ordered a helmet and I'm just so confused by the whole process on your website.
I can certainly help you look into that. To make sure I understand, what specifically is the issue with the helmet? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference?

Oh, it's the color. The color on the website looked completely different. My partner said the darker shade isn't good for safety on the road. The box is still unopened, I was too nervous to even look at it again. It's all just a bit much. Can't you just help me?
Of course, I understand completely. Let me just pull up the return policy for you. I can see you received the delivery five days ago, is that correct?
Yes, I think that's right. I've been so stressed I haven't kept track.
No problem at all. Okay, I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day window for a return. Since the box is unopened, we can definitely get this processed for you right away.
Oh, really? That's such a relief. Thank you! I was so worried it would be a problem.
It's my pleasure to help. I've just started the return on my end and sent a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account. You can just print that out and attach it to the shipping box.
That's wonderful. Thank you so much, Isaac.
You're very welcome. Once we receive the item back at our warehouse, your refund will be processed. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No, that's everything. You've been a great help.
Happy to hear it. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a great day.
